text: From repository to running service. Your infrastructure and delivery, together in your cloud.
Create the foundation once. Planton provisions the network, runtime, and database in dependency order. Your team gets an environment it can reuse.
Start with your application code, prepared by a developer or coding agent. A matching GitHub change triggers the pipeline. Planton builds an artifact and deploys to development.
Keep production under your control. The protected stage waits for human approval. Then, promote the same artifact with production configuration, and keep a deployment record.
Dogfooding, in practice. This is our real, self-hosted Planton instance on G K E, which we use to manage Planton SaaS. See the foundation and Kubernetes workloads in one architecture view.
Your team ships. Your cloud stays yours. See it with your stack. Book a demo.
